_meta.purpose: Force level/service/event/status to keyword. monitor-check.py queries level.keyword:error; on a text mapping that query matches nothing, which reads as 'all clear' rather than as a broken index.
_meta.filebeat_does_not_create_it: filebeat.yml sets setup.template.enabled: false on purpose, so this must be applied to Elasticsearch separately.
_meta.caveat: A template only affects indices created after it. An existing index keeps its mapping; delete or reindex it if existing data matters.
